opening.argument: The video directly promotes Forsage registration by promising daily income growth to viewers who sign up, while presenting purported personal earnings as evidence of the opportunity. The recruitment-oriented account displays an invite link, 90 partners, and a team of 417, reinforcing that participation is tied to network expansion. Yet the spoken claim of earning 15,000 dollars per day conflicts with the visible calculation of 6,385 PKR, making the earnings presentation materially misleading. The description likewise advertises “Forsage Daily Income With Proof Real Platform Blockchain Registration” and directs viewers to WhatsApp for details.
